title: Status Step
statement: Implement `solve(current, nxt)`. An order may move `cart` to `placed`, `placed` to `paid` or `cancelled`, and `paid` to `shipped`. Any other jump returns `current` unchanged. `shipped` and `cancelled` have no exits.
hints: Store the allowed next statuses in a dict of lists.
If nxt is in the list for current, return nxt.
Otherwise return current. A missing status has an empty list.
editorial: A status graph is data. Encoding it as a dict makes an illegal edge obvious and keeps the function from growing a new condition per edge. Returning the old status, rather than raising, matches a handler that ignores a duplicate click.
